items.title: Vextis
items.summary: An agent-assisted ERP prototype that takes a purchase order PDF through stock checks, human approval, and invoicing. A Java core controls business writes while a separate Python runtime coordinates the agents.

claims.statement: Vextis separates the Java Spring Boot enterprise core, which owns CRM, inventory, and billing writes, from a Python Gemini agent runtime that acts through bounded tools.
The documented order-to-cash demo extracts purchase order details from a PDF, checks and reserves stock, and pauses for human approval before issuing an invoice.
The Angular Mission Control interface shows agent activity and an audit trail for the demonstrated ERP workflow.

items.title: Kinetiq V
items.summary: A workout platform with phone-based target enrollment and a separate computer vision engine for tracking a selected person and analyzing exercise movement.

claims.statement: The separate OpenCV 5 computer vision engine implements session-specific person tracking and temporal exercise analysis behind versioned REST contracts.
A Django GraphQL backend owns routines and workout session state and integrates with the separate vision service.
The phone asks the athlete to select and confirm a detected person before their movement can affect the workout session.

items.title: JobTY
items.summary: A job-search assistant prototype that reads PDF résumés and evaluates vacancies against a candidate profile, returning a fit score with reasons, concerns, and a recommendation.

claims.statement: JobTY uses an LLM to evaluate a vacancy against a parsed candidate profile and returns a structured fit score, reasons, concerns, and a recommendation.
The backend extracts text from a PDF résumé and passes it to a configured LLM to produce a structured candidate profile.
The development snapshot defines a Next.js frontend and a FastAPI backend in Docker Compose, with SQLite configured as the default database.
